ai_summary: NCS is a free national job portal connecting job seekers with employers and counselling.
ai_explanation: NCS offers a unified platform where job seekers register, build resumes, and apply to vacancies, while employers post jobs. It also provides career counselling and training information through Model Career Centres.
common_questions: How do I register on NCS?
How do I find jobs on NCS?
